svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for New Product Design and First Release. A long track runs across a dotted floor. At its start a sketch on paper, a wireframe and a dashed AI-built prototype enter. They pass through a giant selection box, the design gate, where the screen becomes clear, then between giant code brackets, the build gate. The product comes out solid onto a launch stage, as a phone with its button in lime, where pale customers are already arriving. Two solid blue Tcules people stand beside the track with a fingertip on it.
